description: This PHP source file defines the TLSmarty class, which extends the Smarty templating engine to provide a customized wrapper for the TestLink project. The file includes functions for translating test case statuses, a guard function for template inclusion, and the TLSmarty class that manages template directories, image assets, and plugin registrations relevant to the TestLink GUI.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A subclass of Smarty that provides additional initialization and resource management tailored for the TestLink project. It manages template directories, plugin registration, image assets, and configuration settings to facilitate GUI rendering in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TLSmarty instance with testlink-specific template directories, configurations, images, and Smarty plugin registrations.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the array of image assets initialized in the TLSmarty instance.

methods.name: getImageSet
methods.description: Static method that constructs and returns a set of image URLs used throughout the TestLink GUI.
